Synopsis:
    Anthropic has reportedly been brought back into good standing with the Trump administration after a legal dispute with the Pentagon over AI safety constraints. The DOD had blocked Anthropic from military contracts after the company refused to allow its Claude models to be used for domestic surveillance or autonomous weapons. A California judge ruled in Anthropic's favor on Aug 27. Commerce Secretary Lutnick's public endorsement signals a potential normalization of Anthropic's government relationships, while Anthropic's co-founder Tom Brown was simultaneously lobbying G20 officials to facilitate data center permitting globally.
